scope: Batch 2 Phase 2 (Milestones D to F): deterministic browser QA with evidence, bounded repair through the canonical path, same-project iteration with safe restore and diff, verified source export, and customer-owned GitHub export with explicit approval. Disabled by default; nothing is applied, deployed or enabled and no external account was touched.

keep: Canonical scheduler, tryUniversalBuild, SoftwareAgent/Cline, live-preview coordinator and project runtime
Existing Playwright loader and Chromium discovery
Existing vault-held GitHub token and authorized GitHub transport
extend: Browser QA, repair loop, restore/diff and export around the existing builder projects
playwrightDriver exports its Chromium loader and discovery for the QA driver

schemaImpact.rollout: Additive migration (two tables). Depends on the Phase 1 migration. Not applied by this change; apply through the verified migration workflow after review.
schemaImpact.rollback: DROP TABLE public.builder_external_operations, public.builder_verifications. Nothing else references them.

auth.description: New Phase 2 routes require the issued tenant context; project, revision, verification and operation ids are resolved against the verified owner and a foreign id returns 404.

tenant.description: New owner-scoped tables with RLS (owner SELECT only for the browser role); every store method filters by the verified owner.

approval.description: Every external GitHub change goes prepare, approve (quoting the plan digest, expiring) and execute, with a database-arbitrated single in-flight operation. Approval is never inferred from model text.

credentials.description: GitHub tokens are read only from the existing vault at execution time and never stored in plans, receipts, logs or responses. Exports and pushes refuse credential files and credential-like content.

egress.description: The QA browser is restricted to the application origin and records blocked requests; navigation is limited to paths on the application.

cost.description: Repairs run through the existing budget reservation with a pre-check and a bounded attempt count. No external billable resource is created without approval.

billing.description: No payment or subscription path changes.

tests.scope: Plan derivation and runner semantics: never passed without execution, regression flags, classification.
Real Chromium against real HTTP servers: defects detected, repair guarded, regression caught, origin lock, no-runtime is pending.
Archive integrity: tamper, traversal, completeness, credential exclusion.
GitHub approval, retries, wrong account, revoked token, divergence, tenant isolation, adapter contract.
HTTP layer: identity required, cross-tenant 404, approval flow.
The Phase 2 migration SQL and the browser tests in CI.

architecture.reason: Adds QA, restore, export and GitHub around the existing canonical path. No scheduler, runtime, browser stack, agent framework or authentication system is added.

rollout: Merge only after review and your authorization. Then apply both builder migrations, enable the canonical engine for builder projects, deploy to the Google runtime and set NEXT_PUBLIC_XROGA_BUILDER=1, each as a separate approved step.
rollback: Disable NEXT_PUBLIC_XROGA_BUILDER; routes are inert without a project. Remove the schema with the rollback statements above.
knownGaps: No live QA of a generated app and no live repair run: they need the Google runtime and the enabled canonical engine
Persistence checks need a disposable test database in the QA environment
GitHub is verified against an in-memory GitHub and request-level contract tests; live creation is pending an approved test account
Phase 3 (Supabase, Vercel, golden acceptance) is not started
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Live browser QA and repair of a generated application on the Google runtime are unverified
Live GitHub repository creation is unverified

blockers: Migrations not applied and canonical engine not enabled

No approved GitHub test account for live repository creation
